symbols.note: copied from `gatekit symbols system <name> --dll dx11 --full` (addresses are bg3_dx11.exe; the Toolkit's own methods without an address were not found in the game binary and are listed with address null; the per-frame update address is not printed for bg3_dx11.exe by this command, it was found by reading the factory in pseudo-code). Parsed by script from the command output, not retyped.
symbols.limits: reads/writes: the component views in the parameters of the system's exported methods. uses: the component operations (add, remove, get, has) its per-frame update performs through the engine's out-of-line helpers, itself or in a function it calls (depth 2), with the call site; kind index: a matched method reads the type's index and the operation is not known. Not listed: operations the compiler inlined, those deeper than depth 2, and what a method that is not the update does (e.g. a SystemLoad) - read its pseudo-code; an empty writes list is not "writes nothing".

does.text: Fills a set of entities through two collector functions and then gives each member a one-frame SurprisedJoinRequestOneFrameComponent. A shared test (0x322D580) returns true when the entity has a SurprisedStealthRequestOneFrameComponent, otherwise falls through to a further lookup. The first collector, per entity of its query that fails the test, adds the entity when a member of a related group passes the test, or when 0x322DE70 (which asks the system's ISurprisedSystemHelper) says yes. The second, per entity of its query, walks the members of a resolved group and adds each member for which the helper says yes and the shared test is false.
does.evidence: bg3_dx11.exe factory 0x234BE10 -> entry 0x238F2E0 -> update 0x322D6C0, which calls 0x322DB00 and 0x322D830 (collectors) and then adds SurprisedJoinRequestOneFrameComponent per set member; shared test 0x322D580; helper call through the object at system+0x20 (the constructor takes a UniquePtr<ISurprisedSystemHelper>) in 0x322D830 and 0x322DE70. Read as pseudo-code.
